description: Every 10s, gain n% ATK for 6s.

description: Every 5s, reduce the target's DEF by n% for 3s.

name: Death Toll
description: Every 12s, deal damage equal to n% of the target's current HP.

description: Every 11s, grant all allies n% DEF for 5s.

description: Every 15s, gain n% ATK for 7s.

description: Every 4 basic attacks, strike for 100% ATK ignoring DEF.

description: Every 8s, grant all allies n% DEF for 5s.

name: Royal Challenge

name: Sunlit Balm
description: Every 6s, heal all allies for n% of missing HP over 4s.
